_comment: NRS1/NRS2 per-detector offset A/B variant (2026-07-29 audit follow-up). The production preset shares ONE offset across the G395H detectors; much of the JWST transit literature fits the two NRS detectors separately (independent systematics), and the bridge measurement on the CM24 CSVs gives NRS1-NRS2 = -69 +/- 33 ppm via PRISM (2.1 sigma) / +7 +/- 60 ppm via NIRCam -- marginal, so this is a robustness A/B, not a fix. Splitting is pure case-file regrouping: the offset design is built per group (observations.build_offset_design), so two groups here means two offset parameters (reference stays NIRISS, the wavelength-first group). theta grows by 1 (11-D); everything else inherits the gpu preset. Compare posteriors + logZ at matched solver settings against the production run. Submit like any override: SMC_RETRIEVAL_OVERRIDES_FILE=overrides/g395h_split_offsets.json (+ its own SMC_RETRIEVAL_OUT_DIR so the production checkpoint is untouched).
